verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, but it also runs client software platforms (GDHQ, the Contract Generator, the D&O Questionnaire Portal), so a published API spec is a fair question. No evidence shows any public API or downloadable OpenAPI spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
